column1: TABLE 4. Total Cell Number in Five Human Cerebella (10^6)^1

^1Coefficient of error (SEM/mean) is shown in parentheses after individual values. Coefficient of variation (SD/mean) between cerebella is shown in parentheses after the mean value for each column and /g and /m refers to cells in either granular or molecular layer. The granular layer is the reference volume for granule, Purkinje, Golgi/g, glial/g cells; and the molecular layer is the reference volume for glial/m and neurons/m.
